question:
Select the most appropriate antonym to substitute the (bracketed) word in the given sentence.

Given (sufficient) effort, all known infectious agents can be specifically identified.
solution:
The correct answer is "**trivial**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence means that if enough effort is given, all infectious agents can be identified.
 
• The antonym of "sufficient" in the sentence would mean that not enough effort was given, which would make the sentence untrue. 
 
 
• **"Sufficient" means enough to meet the needs of a situation or a proposed end.**(पर्याप्त)
 
 
• Example: This evidence is sufficient to prove him wrong.
 
 
 
• **"Trivial" means ****of little worth or importance.**(क्षुद्र) 
 
 
• ​Example: This is trivial information and not enough to be used as a proof.
 
 
 
 
 
• Therefore, the word "trivial" is the appropriate antonym of the word "sufficient."

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1: "Optimal" means the best or most favorable.(इष्टतम)

 
 
• It does not convey the opposite meaning of "sufficient".
 
 
 
• Option 3: "Captivity" means the state of being imprisoned or confined.(क़ैद)
 
 
• It is not relevant to the sentence.
 
 
 
• Option 4: "Unrefined" means not processed or purified.(अपरिष्कृत)
 
 
• It is not relevant to the sentence.
